title: Connect Finance Daycare Report v1
description: One fiscal year of the real Daycare (MDO) Report -- finance_daycare_entries rows restricted to the two sources Andrew's own explicit decision counts toward the report's real totals (source='church_budget_import', extracted from the church's own Budget import by MDO-account-name matching, plus any direct source='manual_budget_override' edit), each already classified into one of a closed 8-category set, plus a live percentage-of-church-actual Utilities/Insurance allocation. This is NOT a myMDO cross-product read -- it is Finance's own already-classified data; the separate myMDO-sourced daycare-app sync (source='daycare_api') and one-off source='manual' rows are deliberately excluded from every total here, exactly as production excludes them. Real money crosses this contract, so it is 'aggregate' like Giving/Budget/Church Report/Balance Sheet, not 'structural' like Chart of Accounts.

fiscalYear.description: finance_daycare_entries.period is always a bare 4-digit year string for both counted sources -- confirmed directly in persistDaycareEntriesFromChurchBudget and the finance/daycare/budget-override handler, which always write period=String(year), never YYYY-MM.

categories.description: May legitimately be empty for a fiscal year with nothing imported on either the daycare or church side yet -- that is a normal state, not an error. One row per category (never split by actual/budget the way the synthetic staging fixture's rows are); Utilities and Insurance are included here only when the church side has fiscal-year data to derive them from.

allocation.description: MDO has no Utilities/Insurance accounts of its own -- it shares the church's building. Per an explicit user decision, these two Daycare Report lines are a LIVE percentage of the CHURCH side's own actual Utilities/Insurance expense for the same fiscal year, recomputed every time (never a stored dollar figure). Always present, even for a fiscal year with no church data (in which case the church*ActualCents/mdo*Cents fields are all 0).

utilityPct.description: From finance_settings' finance_daycare_allocation_config JSON blob; defaults to 0.5 when unset, matching the real finance/daycare/allocation-config route's own default.

churchUtilityActualCents.description: The church side's own actual Utilities expense for this fiscal year, precedence-resolved the same way Church Report resolves it (resolveChurchYearPrecedence).

incomeActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents for classification 'Income' (the 'Tuition Income' category only).

expenseActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents for classification 'Expenses', including the live Utilities/Insurance allocation when present.

category.description: A closed 8-value set. classifyMdoAccountCategory() (src/api-finance.js) can only ever produce the first 5 plus its catch-all 'Other Expenses'; 'Utilities'/'Insurance' are the two live-derived allocation categories and never a stored finance_daycare_entries row.

classification.description: 'Income' for 'Tuition Income' only (exact match); 'Expenses' for every other category. Unlike Church Report, there is no Other Income/Cost of Goods Sold concept here.

actualCents.description: Never null -- unlike Church Report's budgetCents, every category here always has an actual figure (0 if nothing posted).

budgetCents.description: Never null. A manual_budget_override row REPLACES (never adds to) the church_budget_import budget total for this exact category -- the override wins outright.
